};

vector<Edge> E;

int maxflow(int source, int sink) {
    int total_flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        vector<int> prev(ady.size(), -1);
        vector<int> dist(ady.size(), -1);
        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push(source);
        dist[source] = 0;
        
        while (!Q.empty()) {
            int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
            for (int i = 0; i < ady[u].size(); ++i) {
                int e = ady[u][i];
                int v = E[e].v;
                if (E[e].c > 0 && dist[v] == -1) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    prev[v] = e;
                    Q.push(v);
                    if (v == sink) break;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (prev[sink] == -1) break;
        
        int path_flow = INT_MAX;
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v = E[prev[v]].u) {
            path_flow = min(path_flow, E[prev[v]].c);
        }
        
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v = E[prev[v]].u) {
            E[prev[v]].c -= path_flow;
            E[E[prev[v]].r].c += path_flow;
        }
        
        total_flow += path_flow;
    }
    return total_flow;
}

void add_edge(int u, int v, int capacity, bool directed = true) {
    Edge e1(u, v, capacity, E.size() + 1);
    ady[u].push_back(E.size());
    E.push_back(e1);
    
    Edge e2(v, u, directed ? 0 : capacity, E.size() - 1);
    ady[v].push_back(E.size());
    E.push_back(e2);
}

int dy[4] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

    return x * n + y;
}

void spread_infection(vector<vector<int>>& infected, int t_max) {
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                infected[i][j] = 0;

                infected[i][j] = INT_MAX;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y] = q.front(); q.pop();
        if (infected[x][y] >= t_max) continue;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && grid[nx][ny] != 'Z' && infected[nx][ny] == INT_MAX) {
                infected[nx][ny] = infected[x][y] + 1;
                q.push({nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }
}

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

                int lab_id = get_id(i, j);

                    add_edge(v, u, 1, true);
                }
